pages.text: Create fluids flow through $(item)Fluid Pipes$() driven by a $(item)Mechanical Pump$(). Without a pump, pipes only connect; they do not move liquid.

pages.title: Mechanical Pump
pages.text: Its arrow shows flow direction, not the rotation. Wrench it to flip. It pulls from the pipe behind it and pushes into the pipe in front, up to 16 blocks.

pages.title: Fluid Tank
pages.text: Stores fluid. Tanks can be joined up to 3 wide and many layers tall. In survival you cannot fill them by hand, use pipes, spouts or drains.

pages.title: Spout
pages.text: Fills items beneath it, such as buckets or potions, from a fluid supply. Items sit on a depot or belt under it.

pages.title: Item Drain
pages.text: Empties fluid out of items like buckets and bottles into pipes. Right-click to pour from your hand.

$(thing)Big supplies$(): a pipe end in a pool pulls source blocks, and a vanilla water pool with two sources refills itself. A $(item)Hose Pulley$() lowered into a large enough body, such as an ocean, gives or drains without running out.

pages.title: Hose Pulley
pages.text: Fills or drains a whole pool, from the top down to the hose end. It needs rotation to lower.
